title: Settings
unsavedBody: Your edits on this screen will be lost.

profile.title: My information
profile.name: Name
profile.invalidHeight: Enter a height between 100 and 250 cm.

units.title: Units
units.subtitle: Only changes how values are shown. Your saved data never changes.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.accentHint: Used for main actions, progress and the logo.

about.title: About
about.privacy: All your data stays on this device. No account. No tracking.
about.diagnosticsHint: Logs and error codes only, never your personal values.
about.licensesBody: VYRO is built with Expo, React Native and other open-source libraries.

redo.title: Redo setup?
redo.body: You'll go through onboarding again, prefilled with your answers. Choosing a new starter plan replaces your current weekly plan.

texts.missedBody: Reschedule it or skip it — your choice.
texts.weightBody: Log your weight in two taps.
texts.measurementBody: Only fill in what you measure.
texts.photoBody: Same spot, same light — it stays private.
texts.backupBody: Export your VYRO data to a file you control.

screen.masterHint: Local only. Nothing is sent to a server.
screen.denied: Notifications are blocked for VYRO. Allow them in system settings to get reminders.
screen.nudgeHint: Morning nudge on days with untimed sessions
screen.quietHint: Reminders without a fixed time move out of quiet hours.
screen.timers: Rest and interval timers alert you during workouts when VYRO is in the background.

lock.title: Unlock VYRO
lock.wait: Too many attempts. Try again in {{time}}.
lock.resetBody: This only removes the lock. Your data and photos stay on this device — the lock is a privacy barrier, not encryption.
lock.setupHint: 4 to 6 digits. It stays on this device.

appLock.enableHint: Ask for biometrics or your PIN to open VYRO.
appLock.noBiometrics: No biometrics enrolled on this device.
appLock.workoutHint: While a workout is active, lock only after 15 min away.
appLock.confirmDisable: Confirm it's you to turn off the lock.

privacy.previewsHint: The app switcher shows the VYRO logo instead of your data.
privacy.screenshotsHint: Photo screens always block screenshots. Turn on to block them everywhere.
privacy.staysBody: Everything. Your plan, workouts, body data and photos are stored only on this device. VYRO has no account and uploads nothing. Photos live in private app storage, never in your gallery.
privacy.backupsBody: VYRO opts out of Android cloud backup, so your data isn't copied to Google. On iPhone, app data can be part of your encrypted device backup. Use Settings → Backup to export a file you control.
privacy.honest: The lock is a privacy barrier against casual access, not encryption.

backup.title: Backup & export
backup.intro: Your data lives only on this device. Export a backup file and keep it somewhere safe.
backup.dataOnlyHint: Workouts, plan, body data and settings. Photos are listed but not included.
backup.withPhotosHint: Large, and contains your private images. Store it carefully.
backup.reminder: Remind me to back up monthly
backup.mergeHint: Add missing records; keep the newer version when both exist.
backup.replaceHint: Wipe the data on this device, then restore the backup.
backup.confirmMerge: This will add data from the backup to this device.
backup.confirmReplace: This will replace all local data. A safety copy is kept on this device.

errors.PARSE: This file can't be read. Choose a VYRO backup (.json or .zip).
errors.NOT_BACKUP: This isn't a VYRO backup file.
errors.NEWER_VERSION: This file is from a newer version of VYRO. Update the app to import it.
errors.CHECKSUM: The file is damaged (checksum mismatch). Nothing was changed.
errors.INVALID_ROW: The file contains invalid data ({{detail}}). Nothing was changed.
errors.FOREIGN_KEY: The file is incomplete: some records point to missing data ({{detail}}). Nothing was changed.
errors.UNKNOWN: Import failed. Your data was not changed.

backup.encryption: Backups are not encrypted. Keep the file private.

activities.title: Activities
activities.intro: Choose the icon and colour of each activity type. They're used across Home, Start, Plan and history.

ai.title: AI assistant
ai.enableHint: Off by default. The app works the same without AI. Nothing is sent unless you tap an AI button.
ai.offHint: Turn on AI features in Settings → AI assistant first.
ai.keyStored: Key saved securely on this device
ai.keyNote: Stored in the phone's secure storage. Never shown again, never logged, never included in backups.
ai.webKeyNote: Web preview: the key is kept in memory for this session only.
ai.modelHint: Leave empty to use the default ({{model}}).
ai.includeNotesHint: Off by default. Names, photos and file paths are never sent.
ai.usage: You pay your provider for usage with your own key. Answers for the same data are cached, so they aren't billed twice.
ai.privacy: What is sent: aggregated training counts, completion rates, weight trend, goal and exercise names. Never: your name, photos, files, exact times or date of birth.

consent.title: Use {{provider}}?
consent.body: VYRO will send a short summary of your training (counts, trends, goal — no name, no photos) to {{provider}} using your own API key. You can turn AI off at any time.
consent.never: Nothing is sent automatically or in the background.

preview.title: What will be sent
preview.body: This summary goes to {{provider}}. Nothing else leaves your phone.
preview.skip: Don't show again for this type

insight.cantApply: This suggestion can't be applied any more
insight.basedOn: Based on your recorded data from {{from}} to {{to}}.

coach.title: AI Coach
coach.offTitle: Turn on AI to ask your coach
coach.ask: What would you like to know?
coach.adaptTitle: Which workout, and what's different today?
coach.adaptHint: e.g. No cable machine today, short on time…

setup.title: Setup file (editable)
setup.intro: Your profile, goals, equipment, exercises, workouts (sets, reps, weights, rest, run speeds) and cycle days as one JSON file. Edit it on your computer and import it back. History and statistics are never changed.
setup.confirmBody: {{workouts}} workouts, {{exercises}} custom exercises and {{days}} cycle days will replace your current setup. History stays as it is; a safety copy is made first.
setup.imported: Setup applied · {{workouts}} workouts, {{exercises}} exercises, {{days}} cycle days
